Hi Anya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re ready to kick off vendor onboarding so procurement can create a PO and set up payments. To keep the timeline tight (aiming to issue the first PO by 2026-12-22), can you share the items below by end of day Monday (2026-12-21)?

Required buyer intake & vendor setup items:
- Legal entity name (exactly as it appears on W‑9 / tax docs)
- Tax ID / TIN (for 1099/W‑9 match)
- Remit-to address for invoices
- Preferred payment method: ACH (preferred) or wire; include bank name, account number, routing (and SWIFT if wire)
- ACH authorization (signed) or bank letter on company letterhead (bank confirmation of account name and last 4 digits)
- Primary PO contact (name, email, phone) and email address where Redwood can send POs

Optional but helpful:
- Vendor contact for billing disputes / invoices
- Any specific invoicing instructions (PO number placement, tax handling)

I’ve attached our buyer intake form to this thread for convenience and included a DocuSign link for the ACH authorization if you prefer that route. If you have any security questions about Redwood’s handling of bank details, loop in procurement-security@redwood.com and I’ll get you the right contact.

Thanks, and please let us know if you need a short call to walk through the form.

—Marissa
